meta.title: Vendor e-mail when a counter offer is sent
gaps: Open QA vendor mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor receives exactly one counter-offer email containing accept/reject links, while no other vendor or real supplier receives an email.

steps.note: Start creating the RFQ test event.
Enable the RFQ counter-offer option required by the case.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage, which supports counter offers.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add one product so the RFQ has a bid line.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two QA vendors so the later mailbox check can distinguish the concerned vendor from another vendor.
Publish the RFQ so a vendor can submit a bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit a portal bid from one invited QA vendor, creating the bid that can receive a counter offer.
Verify the vendor bid was accepted before opening counter-offer controls.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the counter offer can be initiated.
Send a counter offer to the vendor that submitted the bid.
Verify the buyer grid records that the counter offer was initiated.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes of the concerned vendors and verify the counter-offer email, its accept/reject link, exact delivery count, and absence of messages to the other vendor or any real supplier

steps.note: Mailbox access and email-recipient/content verification are not available in the catalog.
Finish with an observable assertion after the tester's mailbox verification task.
